name: Silent Bee
character: No talking, index cards on the table: a sew night that treats quiet as the program.

sections.title: {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: {{guild_name}} meets {{meeting_info}}. We sew. We do not chat. Questions go on an index card, not into the air.

sections.heading: The quiet hours
sections.note: Phones on paper. If you need a word, write it. The kettle is in the hall so it does not whistle in the room.

items.title: Index cards
items.body: A stack in the middle. Need a color match, a seam ripping, a ride home. Write it. Someone will answer on the back.

items.title: The first ten minutes
items.body: A typed sheet on each chair: tonight's light, the iron rule, where the bathroom is. Then silence.

items.title: After
items.body: Fifteen minutes on the sidewalk if you want to talk. Inside stays quiet.

sections.title: A chair in the quiet
sections.body: Dues cover the room and the card stock. Conversation is extra, and it happens outside.

sections.title: About {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: A guild for people who sew worse when the room is a conversation.

sections.heading: How we started
sections.html: Sample text — replace me: Most guilds are social, and that is fine. {{guild_name}} is for the night you want the machine, not the news. We still have dues, a roster, and a charity pile. We do not have a program chair with a microphone.

items.title: January reset
items.body: We rewrite the chair sheet. New members get the rules on paper, not a speech.

items.title: June long sew
items.body: Four hours, two card breaks, still no talking inside.

items.title: December sidewalk
items.body: The one night the after-talk is planned. Inside is still quiet.

sections.title: The Cards
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: How a question moves without a voice.

items.title: Write
items.body: One question, one card, your first name. Put it in the center bowl.

items.title: Answer
items.body: If you can help, write on the back and walk it to their chair. Do not announce it.

items.title: Keep
items.body: Useful answers go in a binder by the door. The binder is the archive of the quiet.

items.q: What if there is an emergency?
items.a: Speak. Quiet is a preference, not a vow that outranks safety.

items.q: May I bring a friend who talks?
items.a: Not to this night. There are other guilds for that friendship.

sections.title: Membership
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Membership is for people who will keep the room quiet on purpose.

items.a: No. It is a sewing silence. You may be any faith or none.

items.q: I am hard of hearing. Is this worse?
items.a: Some of us are. Cards and a well-lit mouth if you need to lip-read an emergency. Ask on a card; we will arrange a chair with a view.
